verdict.rationale: Cognee documents a clear public Python API (.remember, .recall, .improve, .forget) with dedicated reference pages, plus a REST API server (Docker run on port 8000) and CLI wrapping the same operations, giving AI-native users multiple documented, programmatic entry points. missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found all candidate endpoints 404) and no independent third-party corroboration of API robustness beyond vendor docs.
